svg.title: Continuity in the deviation budget extends that small-tail bound to a parameter neighborhood. More explicitly, spend half a requested allowance on the tail at the center and half on the full source difference to a neighboring parameter, converting the latter to the common anchored weighted norm by the finite constant (RB5) and its support-weight counterpart. Restricting the difference to the debris subfamily cannot increase its positive majorant. Thus the neighborhood works for every sufficiently large depth. A finite subcover of the compact band gives a single depth. Combin- ing it with the uniform beacon depth proves the simultaneous retirement used in (FCC1). The canonical fixed-layout curve argument already given then transfers this depth to every compatible presentation; the construction here supplies its weighted continuity and actual finite beacons.
